properties.description: Production pipeline to process files within a SharePoint subfolder via Microsoft Graph API. Handles pagination via Until loop with @odata.nextLink, refreshes OAuth2 token every 45 minutes, and applies configurable throttle delays between pages.

activities.name: Set_InternalAccessToken
activities.description: Copy AccessToken parameter to a variable (parameters are immutable in ADF)

activities.name: Set_InternalTokenAcquiredTime
activities.description: Copy TokenAcquiredTime parameter to a variable for refresh tracking

activities.name: Set_InitialPageUrl
activities.description: Set the initial folder children URL with configurable page size

activities.name: Until_AllPagesProcessed
activities.description: Paginate through all folder children pages until no more @odata.nextLink is returned

activities.name: Refresh_ClientSecret
activities.description: Retrieve fresh client secret from Key Vault each iteration

activities.name: Refresh_AccessToken
activities.description: Acquire OAuth2 token (AAD returns cached token if still valid)

activities.name: Get_FolderPage
activities.description: Fetch current page of folder children from Graph API

activities.name: Filter_Files
activities.description: Filter Graph response to only file items

activities.name: Execute_CopyFileBatch
activities.description: Delegate file copying to child pipeline (works around ADF restriction on ForEach inside Until)

activities.name: Set_HasMorePages
activities.description: Set pagination flag based on presence of @odata.nextLink

activities.name: Set_CurrentPageUrl_Next
activities.description: Update page URL to nextLink if present

activities.name: Wait_ThrottleDelay
activities.description: Wait between pages to avoid Graph API throttling
